title: Finished helpers were being woken and re-billed all day; stopped them

owner_note.text: Six helpers that finished this morning with a finish line but no landing stamp were chased by the heartbeat every few minutes, each wake re-reading a big context: bubbles-anchor $72.68, sheet-double-mount $62.20, sheet-handoff-proof $51.56, dictate-wide $39.39, readme-trim $21.46, layout-check-path $20.24 against $3 to $4 budgets, about $270 for nothing, which is why usage kept rising with no agent working. I stopped all twenty finished agents. Next: the heartbeat and the spend gate take "landed" from the one state instead of their own rule, so this cannot happen again.

message.text: Six helpers that finished this morning with a finish line but no landing stamp were chased by the heartbeat every few minutes, each wake re-reading a big context: bubbles-anchor $72.68, sheet-double-mount $62.20, sheet-handoff-proof $51.56, dictate-wide $39.39, readme-trim $21.46, layout-check-path $20.24 against $3 to $4 budgets, about $270 for nothing, which is why usage kept rising with no agent working. I stopped all twenty finished agents. Next: the heartbeat and the spend gate take "landed" from the one state instead of their own rule, so this cannot happen again.

Fixed and merged (e6d593c0e): one rule now decides "landed" (Servex/Landed.js, built on Task.replay), so a task ending in a finish or complete line counts as landed everywhere. The heartbeat and compact nudge skip landed agents with one "heartbeat: skipped, landed" log line, and a heartbeat wake that would pass a helper's brief budget is refused. In the test, a $4 helper is woken five times and the sixth is refused, and all six real helper dirs now read as landed. Servex needs a restart to pick this up, which is your step (I did not touch the live one). awaken-race.test.mjs already fails the same way on main, so I left it alone. Details: /framework/servex/doc/task-loop.md

The guard works on the live Servex: its first refusal was a heartbeat wake of the task-system mastermind from Thursday, which had spent $394.45 against a $100 budget. Since the restart no stopped or sleeping agent has gained a cent. The one rule for landed is Servex/Landed.js, documented in Servex/doc/task-loop.md.
helper-clarity-one-pass its agent is not running: it was stopped on purpose by unknown at 2026-10-19T07:39:06-05:00; not revived.

Servex crashed again at 15:12 today with the same silent fail-fast, after two hours up; the supervisor relaunched it within a second. Nothing was captured because the crash breadcrumbs only run once the supervisor itself restarts, which is the one command waiting in your inbox.
